page.overview:
Who is Snake-Eyes?

Within the animated series Snake Eyes appears to be equipped with durable swords that can even deflect heavy energy weapons fire as is shown during his fight against machine Overlord Vector (Reveal 1x04). Also Snake Eyes appears to perform superhuman feats of athletics and martial arts not seen with his Original series counterpart.
